name: 137.1 — a depiction is an Item
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 137.1: a crafting recipe's slots answer widget:item() with a real interned Item, that Item reads its resource and its tooltip while answering absence for every place-read, a write on it is refused naming drawn, not held, a backpack item is unchanged beside it, and a depiction whose icon leaves the tree goes stale while still naming itself.
